source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Report the incident to your WCB, using the correct form for your jurisdiction. If you're not in Canada but report to a Canadian WCB, use the form designed by your WCB.
3. Complete the report within two weeks of the incident or injury. Documentation and WCB submission can't be more than two weeks of the incident.
4. Fill out the form completely.
5. If the form isn't completed in full, call the worker or the worker's family to clarify or lay out the circumstances and nature of the injury or illness.

In Canada:

- BC: [Workers' Compensation and Registrar's Report of Injury](https://forms.worksafe.bc.ca/library/forms/pr06/pr06-nov2019-fillable.pdf?ded778ed9ad64fba9d8f50d44
